text: Because detected photons per symbol set a shot-noise-limited SNR = n-bar, every additional bit of ENOB costs ___ dB more optical energy per symbol.
explanation: One extra bit doubles the required amplitude resolution, and with shot-noise-limited SNR = n-bar this is a factor of about 4 in optical power, i.e. 6 dB per bit. This precision-energy tradeoff is why photonic processors deliver only about 4-8 ENOB.
